explanation: The Bing–Borsuk conjecture: every n-dimensional homogeneous ANR (metrizable, so Hausdorff) is a topological n-manifold, i.e. admits a ChartedSpace structure modelled on ℝⁿ. The dimension uses Lebesgue covering dimension, which agrees with other notions for separable metric spaces. The statement matches Wikipedia. One fine point: the conclusion asks only for some charted-space structure on X's own topology, which is the intended notion of being an n-manifold. The statement is faithful.
